description: Replication package for: Overtaken but overloaded: a moving reporting boundary conceals a capacity crisis in Taiwan's municipal waste account is published by Chiu, Shih-Yung; Wang, Tzu-Chia. The package reconstructs municipal-waste reporting and capacity measures from public environmental releases. Its stated coverage is Taiwan; the study's administrative reporting series. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists CSV resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Changing reporting boundaries are central to the analysis and must not be treated as physical capacity changes without adjustment. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
